exposure: fetal heart rate patterns on cardiotography (CTG)
cohort: 204 patients admitted to one of four hospitals in Pakistan from July 2019 to December 2019 who underwent cardiotography (CTG).
finding: A statistically significant association exists between fetal heart rate (FHR) patterns on CTG and neonatal outcome, with reactive traces associated with the best outcomes and pathological traces associated with the worst outcomes.
mod_finding: The highest percentage of cesarean deliveries was observed in the pathological CTG group (58.3%).
